title: RecordingCommand
description: Arguments for start_recording / stop_recording, plus the recordingState payload emitted on the 'recording://state' app event.

command.description: Which recording command this payload accompanies.

trackIds.description: Optional explicit set of track UUIDs to capture (start only). Omitted/null = record all armed tracks.

startedAtSamples.description: Timeline position (project samples) where the take began.

xruns.description: Count of buffer over/underruns since capture started; nonzero means possible glitches in the take.

clips.description: Present on the stop notification: finalized clip(s) created by the take.

rehearseSpans.description: Optional. Regions of the take written as silence because rehearse-hold was down. Sample-aligned; the WAV is still one contiguous take.
